title: List of common skills
wikitext:
{{TOCright}}
:'''''Note''': This list '''does not''' include [[List of temporary skills|temporary common skills]] (i.e. disguises and forms skills, mission-specific skills, mini-game skills, etc.) or any of the skills which are commonly available only during the [[special event]]s.''

[[Skill]]s that players can [[Skill#Learning and unlocking skills|learn]] that are not tied to any [[profession]] are called '''common skills'''. With the sole exception of [[Resurrection Signet]], all common skills are [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE only]] by default.
